quality.reason: The report content itself is well-structured and actionable (clear signals with tickers, engagement metrics, scores, and source links), but leaked internal instruction text 'Now format and deliver the Discord report:' at the start indicates a formatting/delivery defect that would appear in the final Discord message.

Well-structured report with concrete actionable metrics (PnL, win rate, active BTC signal with source/strength) but includes partially irrelevant news items with empty token tags and a weak signal (str=0.40) that adds marginal value.

Well-structured report with actionable per-pair strategy scores, margins, and trend deltas (e.g., BTC decline 63.4→48.1 flags review); only minor gap is the incomplete SOL row with unexplained asterisk.

Well-structured output with prioritized actionable alerts (SOL 90% bid-weighted orderbook, TAO OI collapse) backed by a clean multi-metric table, though the truncated whale address section and slight redundancy between alerts and table data leave minor room for improvement.

Well-structured review with specific, actionable signals (meta-agent idle 128d with 0 briefs, arxiv 14d stale, paper-trader -$483, per-agent health deltas), only flaw being the leaked conversational preamble about compaction that should be stripped from the final report.

Well-structured and the missing health records for three services are genuinely actionable, but flagging agents seen just 6-12 minutes ago as warnings suggests overly aggressive thresholds, and if these warnings recur every run without resolution they degrade into noise.

Well-structured digest with relevant paper metadata (arXiv ID, link, author, categories) and a substantive summary tightly matching the job's stated scope of crypto/AI/autonomous agents, though the single visible entry is roughly a month old and the truncated excerpt prevents confirming completeness of the full digest.
